summary: Uranium Royalty Corp. (URC) filed a 6-K containing a management information circular for a special meeting to approve a plan of arrangement with Sweetwater Investors (Orion Resource Partners and Ontario Teachers). Under the deal, Sweetwater contributes its ~92% stake in trona royalty assets for ~US$1.14B in cash and New URC shares (223,252,749 shares at ~US$3.64 each). URC shareholders receive one New URC share per URC share, with exchangeable share options for eligible Canadian holders. The board unanimously recommends voting FOR. The arrangement is under the Canada Business Corporations Act, with New URC listing on Nasdaq. Watch for shareholder vote on July 20 and regulatory/structural closing.
